# Artifact Dock

> Chrome extension and CLI for macOS. Agent-generated HTML opens in a background tab, one tab per document, listed in a side panel, so your focus stays where you were typing.

`open` and `open -g` bring all of Chrome forward. Artifact Dock's CLI (`artifact-open`) asks the extension over a local socket and native messaging, and the extension creates the tab with `tabs.create({active:false})`. If the extension is not connected, the CLI exits with an error and does not open the file.

## Install

- Run: `git clone https://github.com/woorichicken/artifact-dock.git && cd artifact-dock && ./install.sh`
- Add the extension: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/artifact-dock/nfifnjdpmjacfelfapgeibnnbkokceim), or load this folder unpacked and allow access to file URLs
- Check: `artifact-open --status`

## Usage

- `artifact-open report.html`: open in the background; reloads the existing tab for the same file
- `artifact-open a.html b.html`: open several
